QUOTE: `HealthMonitor::monitor_loop` | `health_monitor.cpp:92` | Watches MCP server health | The loop only enqueues. `process_events()` swaps the queue out under `event_mutex_` and runs the callbacks on the engine thread.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the monitor loop only enqueues events, and `process_events()` swaps the queue under `event_mutex_` and runs callbacks on the engine thread, which is the caller-drains-on-its-own-thread mechanism.
